tei:div.tei:p: "$ (351)༄༅// rnam rgyal lha dgu'i sgrub thabs bum chog dang bcas pa bzhugs so/// /

(352)༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ gu ru buddha bo dhi sa twa na mo na maḥ /ye shes lha mo ngo mtshar cha shas ni// rnam pa du mas yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku// nang gi mun sel bdud rtsi'i 'od dkar can// gang khyod 'dir ni rnam par rgyal gyur cig /de la gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi rigs sngags 'di/ gang gā'i klung khrag khrig chen po brgyad cu rtsa brgyad kyi bye ma snyed kyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs shing*/ byin gyis brlabs pas/ ngan 'gro dang las kyi sgrib pa mtha' dag yongs su sbyong ba/ bde 'gro dang bde ba'i lam ston pa/ 'chi ba med pa'i go 'phang myur du thob par byed pa yin par gsungs pas/ blo ldan sngags kyi sgor spyad pa spyod pa rnams kyis/ mchog tu nan tan du bya ba'i 'os so// de la 'di nyid kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa gzhan du 'bri bar 'gyur la/ lha dgu'i rnal 'byor la brten nas khrus chog dang stong mchod sogs bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len du mdzad pa gang yin pa de bri bar bya'o// 'di la cho ga'i sngon du 'gro ba'i bya ba ni/ stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i steng du bum pa spyi dang mthun par bshams/ bum pa'i steng du gzungs 'di'i snying po can (353)gyi rnam rgyal mchod rten bzhugs su gsol/ mañdzi sogs stegs mtho ba la/ dung chos sam zangs chos su mchod yon chu gtsang la 'o ma dang me tog dkar po btab pa bzhag /mchod pa gzhan rnams bshams tshul ni/ phyis kyi bla ma 'ga' zhig gi phyag len ltar/ byang shar du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog dang mchod yon nas/ zhal zas kyi bar bdun po shar nas byang gi bar du g.yas bskor du byed pa'i lugs bzhin bshams kyang chog /mdun du mchod yon zhabs bsil/ g.yas su me tog bdug spos mar me gsum/ g.yon du zhal zas dri chab/ yang mar me de gsum/ rgyab tu mtshams 'dzin bshams pa'am/ yang na g.yas su nyer spyod lnga dang*/ g.yon du chu gnyis sogs bshams pas chog la/

gcig tu nges par dgos pa ni ma yin no// de bzhin du 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma dang*/ rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma dang*/ cha gsum rnams spyir phyogs la nges pa med kyang*/ 'das gtor dkyil 'khor gyi mdun gyi phyogs dang*/ rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma phyi rol gyi phyogs bzhi/ cha gsum ji ltar bde bar sgrig /yang (354)de ltar mi bde na/ shar du 'jig rten 'das gtor gyi sne 'thung nas rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma sgrigs/ cha gsum ci bde ba'i phyogs su bzhag pas chog gi/ lho nyid du dgos zer ba ni lung rig med do// spyir btang la bum pa dang rten gyi zhal yang 'jig rten shar la blta// ci ste stong mchod byed na/ lha bshos stong dang*/ mar me stong dang*/ bdug spos stong rnams nges par dgos shing*/ gzhan yang gdugs dang ba dan la sogs pa 'grub na stong du tshang bar dgos shing*/ ma 'grub na ji ltar rigs pa bya ba las/ ras sam dar gyi tshal pa phra mos kyang rung mod/ dug can gyi shog bu la 'bri ba dang*/ ras bris dri ma can gyis ni go mi chod do// de 'dra byed pa de ni/ gang la bya ba'i bsgrub bya la phan mi thogs pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la brnyas par 'gyur ba dang*/ lag len ngan pas lag len bzang po sun 'byin pa'i spyod par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ ring du dor bar bya'o// mchod pa de rnams ni bum pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' la bskor kyang rung*/ stegs bu gzhan la bkod nas phyogs bzhi nas bskor kyang rung ngo*// gtor ma stong phrag kyang de ltar bkod na rung mod kyi/ gtor snod gzhan du sgrigs pa'i lag len gtso che la/ gzhan yang rol mo sogs dgos pa'i yo byad tshang bar byas te/ de rnams lag len mthong ba las kyang shes par bya'o// de nas thams cad khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du 'gro bas/ sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa'i dge 'dun sogs nam mkha' gang ba la dmigs nas/

phyag 'tshal rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba re bya ste/ de yang las dang po pa'i rim pa chos spyod khrigs chags su bshad zin to// de nas bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum bya ste/ me tog dam pa zhes sogs mchod pa'i tshigs bcad gsum po la rol chen byed/ de nas bsnyen gnas rang gis blang ba'i cho ga byed pa zhig snang ba la/ cho ga byed pa po thams cad dge tshul yan chad kyi sdom pa thob la ma nyams pa yin na/ bsnyen gnas blang dgos pa ma yin zhing*/ dge (355)tshul dge slong gi sdom pa ma thob pa sha stag yin na/ nges par blang bar bya la/ rab byung gi sdom pa thob ma thob 'dres ma yin na/ len pa dang mi len pa'i dbye ba so sor byed dgos pa yin kyang*/ dus kyi tha ma 'di lta bur lag len ltar snang gi cho ga gra sgrig dgos pa 'di 'dra'i rigs la/ rab byung gi sdom pa ma thob pa rnams kyis bsnyen gnas len pa'i zhor la/ dge slong dang dge tshul rnams kyang ji srid 'tsho'i bar du rang gi sdom pa brtan por dam 'cha' ba'i bsam pas/ cho ga de kha ton du byed pa tsam la 'gal ba med do// de la cho ga ni 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rta cang shes lta bu/ glang po chen po/ bya ba byas shing*/ byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ rang gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid pa kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i bka' legs par rnam par grol ba'i thugs/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i shes rab can de rnams kyis/ sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir dang*/ phan par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang*// nad med par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub nges par rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/

gso sbyor nges par mdzad pa de bzhin du bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang*/ dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du/ gso sbyong nges par yang dag par blang bar bgyi'o// (356)de nas srog gcod mi bya zhing*// gzhan gyi nor ni blang mi bya// 'khrig pa'i chos kyang mi spyad cing*// rdzun gyi tshig kyang mi smra'o// skyon ni mang po nyer brten pa'i// chang ni yongs su spang bar bya// khri gdan che mtho mi bya zhing*// de bzhin dus ma yin pa'i zas// dri dang phreng ba dang ni rgyan// gar dang glu sogs spang bar bya// ji ltar dgra bcom rtag tu ni// srog gcod la sogs mi byed pa// de bzhin srog gcod la sogs spang*// bla med byang chub thob par shog /sdug bsngal mang dkrugs 'jig rten 'di// srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /ces lan gsum brjod/ oṃ a mo gha shī la sambha ra sambha ra bha ra bha ra ma hā shuddha/ sa twa padma bi bhu ṣi te/ bhu dza dha ra dha ra/ sa manta a ba lo ki te hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ ces tshul khrims rnam dag gi gzungs bdun nam nyer gcig bzla/ khrims kyis tshul khrims skyon med cing*// tshul khrims rnam par dag dang ldan// rlom sems med pa'i tshul khrims kyis// tshul khrims pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /ces smon lam gdab/ de dag ni cho ga'i sngon du grub na legs pa'i yan lag yin gyi/ ma byas kyang cho ga chad pa'i skyon du mi 'gyur ro// de nas mchod pa byin brlab pa ni/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog /zhal zas rnams dang*/ gzhan yang rol (357)mo dang*/

phan gdugs la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra padyaṃ= /oṃ badzra puṣpaṃ= /oṃ badzra dhū paṃ= oṃ badzra dī paṃ= /oṃ badzra gandhaṃ= /oṃ badzra nai bi dyaṃ= /oṃ badzra shabda swā hā/ oṃ badzra dharma ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba buddha kṣe tra pra tsa li te/ pradzñā pa ra mi tā nā da sambha wi te/ badzra dharma hṛ da ya ni/ santo ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho āḥkhaṃ swā hā/ rol mo ji snyed pa 'bud dkrol byas te byin dbab/ 'di ma gtogs pa'i mchod pa byin rlabs 'og ma rnams wa dharma ra ṇi dang rol chen mi dgos so// dngos gzhi la bdag bskyed bsgom bzlas/ mdun bskyed sgrub mchod/ gtor ma 'bul ba'o// dang po ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la= /dam pa'i chos rnams la= /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la= /zhes gsum nas nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar ci rigs kyi mthar/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che dam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sgom bzlas la 'jug par bgyi'o/ /zhes (358) lan gsum brjod/ rang skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das mar gsal ba'i thugs kar// a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrūm̐ dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das ma lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa ma dzaḥ

dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog /zhal gsum phyag brgyad rab mdzes zhi ba'i sku// ye shes dpag yas tshe yi mchog stsol ma// rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pādyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gandha/ nai bedya/ shabda pra tītstsha swā hā/ phyag rgya yang spyi dang 'dra'o// de nas thal mo sbyar te rgyun bshags bya ba ni/ 'jig rten dag gi phyogs kun na// de bzhin gshegs pa gang bzhugs dang*// dgra bcom byang chub sems dpa' dag /de dag bdag la dgongs su gsol// tshe rabs gang yang rung ba na// bdag gis sdig pa ci bgyis pa// sngon gyi tshe rabs gzhan dag dang*// tshe rabs 'di dang 'khor ba na// 'dod chags dbang dang blun pa dang*// khro ba dag gis 'khrugs gyur te// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun nam// bla ma dag dang pha ma dang*// dgra bcom byang chub sems dpa' dang*// sbyin gnas gang yang rung ba dang*// de las gzhan pa'i sems can dag /yon tan ldan dang mi ldan la// sdig pa'i las rnams gang bgyis dang*// (359)gang yang bgyid du stsal ba dang*// gang yang cung zad yi rang ba// bag med pas ni phra mo yang*// lus ngag yid kyis bgyis pa rnams// de dag ma lus blos bsdus nas// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sras bcas la// bdag gis da ni mngon sum bzhin// rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal te// skyo ba'i yid du gyur pa yis// thal mo sbyar te nongs pa rnams// yang dang yang du so sor bshags// bdag gis mi dge bgyis pa rnams// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis mkhyen pa bzhin// de ltar bdag gis so sor bshags// slan chad de ltar yongs mi bgyid// mi rtog blo gros bskyed pa'i phyir// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*// gdul bya ji srid tshim bar du// mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba 'debs// srog chags sdug bsngal zhi bya'i phyir// bdag ni ji srid 'tsho yi bar// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// gus pas yang dag skyabs su mchi// sems can khams ni mtha' yas pa'i// sdug bsngal nye bar zhi ba dang*// ngan 'gro rnams las bsgral ba dang*// nyon mongs rnams las dgrol ba'i phyir// srid pa mi bde dwogs pa na// sdug bsngal sna tshogs ci mchis pa// de ltar yongs su skyabs pa'i phyir// bdag gis byang chub sems bskyed do// sems can 'phongs pa thams cad kyi// skyabs su bdag nyid rtag tu shog

/bdag ni mgon med rnams kyi mgon// rten med rnams kyi rten du bdag /skyabs med rnams kyi skyabs 'gyur zhing*// sdug bsngal bde bar byed pa dang*// bdag (360)ni sems can thams cad kyi// nyon mongs zhi bar byed par shog /dge ba'i las rnams gang dang gang*// 'di ni gzhan du bsags pa rnams// bsod nams ye shes zhes bya yi// tshogs ni rnam pa gnyis su shog /pha rol phyin pa drug sgo nas// bdag gis brtson 'grus gang brtsams pa// de yang sems can ma lus pa// thams cad la ni phan par shog /sngon gyi rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyis// smon lam ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin// bdag kyang dge ba'i sems kyis su// de bzhin du ni smon lam 'debs// sems can thams cad bde ba dang*// thams cad nad kyang med par shog /bdag ni bya ba kun nus shing*// yon tan dang yang ldan par shog /nor ldan gtong phod shes rab can// bzod ldan dge la dad pa dang*// sems can tshe rabs thams cad du// skye ba dran zhing brtse ldan shog /ces lan gsum/ shin tu bsdus pa la dga' na/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces zur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags byed/ de nas tshad med bzhi bsgom ste/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig (361)sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dam pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig

/nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig /ces dang*/ /oṃ shū n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang*/ a las zla ba'i steng du bhrūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i mchod rten du gyur pa ni/ rin po che'i rang bzhin seng khri'i steng du padma/ de'i steng du khri zlum po bang rim sum brtsegs/ de'i steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i bum pa zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba sgo dang bcas pa/ steng du rin po che'i bre/ gdugs bcu gsum// char khebs tog dang bcas pa/ me tog gi phreng ba dar gyi lda ldi sogs rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o// de'i bum pa'i nang du padma dang zla ba'i gdan la bhrūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje bhrūm̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros// 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma/ sku mdog dkar mo zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa zhal dkar ba/ g.yas ser ba/ g.yon sngo zhing yid tsam khro ba/ zhal re re zhing zhi ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gnyis pas padma'i steng du 'od dpag tu med pa bzhugs pa bsnams pa/ gsum pas mda'/ bzhi pas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon dang po zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pas gzhu/ gsum pas (362)skyabs sbyin/ bzhi pas 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o// de'i g.yas su spyan ras gzigs dkar po/ phyag g.yas rnga yab dang*/ g.yon padma dkar po'i sdong po 'dzin pa/ g.yon du phyag na rdo rje sngon po/ phyag g.yas rnga yab dang*/ g.yon utpal la gnas pa'i rdo rje sngon po 'dzin pa de gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs shing*/

dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ gzhon nu lang tsho la bab pa/ zhi zhing sgeg pa'i skur gyur/ gtso 'khor gsum gyi phyogs bzhir khro bo bzhi gnas pa ni/ shar du mi g.yo ba g.yas ral gri phyar ba/ lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po g.yas lcags kyu phyar ba/ nub tu dbyug sngon can g.yas dbyug pa phyar ba/ byang du stobs po che g.yas rdo rje rtse gsum phyar ba/ thams cad kyang sku mdog mthing ga rab tu khros pa/ phyag g.yon sdigs mdzub thugs kar gtod cing*/ spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra nag po thor tshugs su byas pa/ stag lpags dang sbrul gyi brgyan can/ rol pa'i khro bo chen po ste/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa'o// gtso mo'i steng gi nam mkha' la gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu gnyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas gtso mo la sku khrus gsol ba/ de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po/ dpral bar trām̐ ser po/ lte bar hrīḥdamar po/ brla gnyis la aṃ (363)aḥljang gu/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma 'khor dang bcas pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇī ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ

de bzhin du sbyar/ ārghaṃ nas/ shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ nas/ shabda pra tītstsha swā hā 'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas// ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag /chu'i lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las/ gtso mo la rnam par snang mdzad/ spyan ras gzigs la 'od dpag med/ phyag na rdo rje dang khro bo bzhi la mi bskyod pa/ lha'i bu gnyis la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇī ṣa bi dza ya sa pā ri wa ra badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ nas/ badzra shabda pra tītstsha swā hā 'i bar gyis mchod/ dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog /zhal gsum phyag brgyad rab mdzes zhi ba'i sku// ye shes dpag yas tshe yi mchog stsol ma// rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes (364)bstod/ /snying gar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la/ bhrūṃm̐ yig bsrung bya sngags phreng dang bcas pa 'khod par gyur/ oṃ hūm̐ tāṃ hīḥ.aṃ āḥ bdag dang bskub bya ba rakṣa rakṣa ku ru swā hā/ zhes cung zad bzlas// lag pa gnyis thal mo mnyam par sbyar ba'i mdzub mo'i tshigs bar pa bcag /mtheb mdzub rtse sprad de gzungs ring tshar gcig brjod la dam la bzhag /de rjes gzungs ring nyid gtso bor bzla zhing*/ sngags thung gnyis kyang ci rigs su bzla'o/ /oṃ a mṛ te// a mṛ todbha be/ a mṛ ta bi krān te/ a mṛ ta ga tre/

a mṛ ta gā mi ni/ a mṛ ta ā yur dad te/ ga ga na/ kī rti ka re sarba karma kle sha kṣa yaṃ ka rī ye swā hā/ zhes pa'ang tshe spel ba'i don du ci nus bzla'o// mthar snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas yongs su drangs te/ bsgom pa'i dkyil 'khor rang gi snying gar thim/ zhes brjod/ ye shes pa gshegs 'dod cing bdag bskyed kho na yin na/ 'og nas 'chad pa'i rjes bsdu de bya zhing*/ mdun bskyed dang 'brel na/ rjes chog gi mthar byas pas rung ba yin la/ spyir bya rgyud kyi lha sngags la/ rgyud sde gong ma'i thun mong gi cho ga sbyar ba 'di rigs la/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs pa mtha' gcig tu yang mi dgos la/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len ltar de ltar byed pa yang mi 'gal lo// gnyis pa ni/ mdun bskyed la dmigs te/ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam (365)gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i bum pa'i steng du/ pam̐ las padma dang*/ a las zla ba'i steng du/ bhrūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i zhes pa nas bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa ma dzaḥ zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma zhes pa'i rang nyid ces pa dor/ sa mā dzaḥ 'i rjes la/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /zhes spro na dbyangs dang bcas pas spyan drangs/ yang mchod pa nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan gyi bar yang gong dang 'dra ba las/

bdag la mngon par ces pa/ 'di la mngon par ces pa spo/ de nas mchod pa gsar pa'ang bshams shing*/ snga ma rnams kyang kha gsos la gong bzhin byin brlab bya/ chu bo gaṅgā'i rgyun bzhin du// arghaṃ'i rgyun yang mi 'chad de// bla med mchod pa 'di 'bul na// thugs rjes dgongs te bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇī ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri bā ra arghaṃ pra titstsha swā hā/ dri zhim reg na bde ba yi// zhabs bsil rgyun yang mi 'chad de// bla med mchod pa 'di 'bul na// thugs rjes dgongs te bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇī ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri bā ra pādyaṃ pra titstsha swā hā/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam nyid kyis// de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ba// de ltar bdag gis lha rnams la// gtsang ma'i chab kyis khrus gsol lo// oṃ sarba de wa ta a rtsi ta a mṛ ta swā hā/ sna tshogs dbang (366)po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing*// gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i// gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul// bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇī ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri bā ra badzra wast+ra ye pra titstsha swā hā/ phreng ba rin chen se mo do shal dang*// rgyan gyi dam pa ma lus phul ba yis// byang chub mchog gi rgyan dang ldan gyur nas// bla med thar pa mchog la gnas par shog /theg mchog bla re mgon skyabs gdugs dang ldan// bdud bcom rgyal mtshan ba dan ting 'dzin 'phan// bdag dang 'gro ba'i don du 'bul lags kyi// dbang mchog dam pa dus 'dir stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇī ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri bā ra u pa stha na pra titstsha swā hā/ sna tshogs rol mo snyan pa'i sgra dag dang*// lha dang mi yi mchod pa'i glu dbyangs kyis// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mdzes par rab brgyan pa// theg pa mchog gi nges pas bgrod par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇī ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri bā ra swa ra na da pra titstsha swā hā/

gtsang zhing gtsang ma las byung ba'i// lha rdzas bzang po'i dri 'di dag /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇī ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri bā ra gandhe ā ha ra ā ha ra sarba bidyā dha ra pū dzi te swā hā/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar skyes pa yi// lha rdzas bzang po'i me tog 'di// bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇī ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri bā ra puṣpe ā ha ra ā ha ra sarba bidyā dha ra pū dzi ta swā hā/ dri (367)yi rgyas pa lha yi rdzas// nags tshal bcud ni yid 'ong 'di// bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣī ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri bā ra dhū be ā ha ra ā ha ra sarba bidyā dha ra pū dzi te swā hā/ sman rnams bcud gtsang yid gar 'ong*// sngags kyi zhal zas mchog 'di dag /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇī ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri bā ra nai wīdya ā ha ra ā ha ra sarba bidyā dha ra pū dzi te swā hā/ gnod pa 'joms shing bkra shis pa// dge zhing mun pa rnams la 'di// bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇī ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri bā ra ā lo ke ā ha ra ā ha ra sarba bidyā dha ra pū dzi te swā hā/ /zhes pa ni mchod pa dkyus so// stong mchod kyi skabs ni/ zhal zas sogs stong phrag tu spel ba la/ mchod pa sgos su bsngo bar 'dod na/ stong tshan lnga po la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyoḥbi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ud ga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ /zhes lan gsum gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ zhal zas/ mar me/ spos rnams la sngags spyi 'gro dang*/ gdugs la/ tshā traṃ ka

/ba dan la/ pa taṃ ka /zhes sbyor ba lan mang du bzlas pas mchod/ snga ma'am stong mchod gang yin yang rung*/ mthar/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan// sems can sdug bsngal sim byed pa'i// sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig /dam chos dkon mchog thams cad dang*// (368)mchod rten rnams dang sku gzugs la// rin chen me tog la sogs char// rgyun mi 'chad pa 'bab par shog /ji ltar 'jam dbyangs la sogs pas// rgyal ba rnams la mchod mdzad pa// de bzhin bdag gis de bzhin gshegs// mgon po sras dang bcas rnams mchod// yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la bdag /bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtshos bstod// bstod dbyangs snyan sprin de dag la// nges par kun tu 'byung gyur cig /tshigs bcad bzhi pa de dag re re'i mthar rol chen dang*/ rol mo byin 'bebs kyi sngags dang*/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs gang rung re brjod/ de nas bstod pa ni/ slob dpon tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa 'di bya ste/ /gtso mo bcom ldan 'das ma ni// puṇḍa ri ka'i me tog ltar// skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar// zhal gsum phyag brgyad spyan gsum mnga'// dbu rgyan mgul rgyan snyan cha'i tshogs// rin chen sna tshogs mdzes pas brgyan// padma zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs// dbus dkar g.yas ser g.yon zhal sngo// khro mo'i zhal ni mche ba gtsigs// phyag g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje dang*// pad steng rgyal ba 'od dpag med// mda' dang mchog sbyin phyag rgya'o// g.yon pa sdigs mdzub zhags pa dang*// gzhu dang mi 'jigs phyag rgya can// rin chen bum pa legs par bsnams// bai ro tsa nas dbu brgyan cing*// 'od zer dkar po 'phro zhing 'du// stod g.yogs lha yi na bza' can// mchod rten na pan legs par bzhugs// blo dang tshe 'phel mdzad pa mo// bcom ldan 'das ma nyid la bstod// g.yas na rje btsun spyan ras gzigs// sku mdog dkar po skyon ma gos// g.yon (369)pas padma g.yas pa na// rnga yab 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo// g.yon na gsang ba'i bdag po ni// utpal mdog 'dra rdo rje g.yon// g.yas pas rin chen rnga yab 'dzin// mthu stobs can la phyag 'tshal lo// shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhi yi// khro bo'i rgyal po bzhi po ni// mdun na khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon// sngo sangs g.yas pa ral gri 'dzin// g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad pa yis// ma rungs 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo// khro chen 'dod pa'i rgyal po ni// sngo sangs lcags kyu 'bar ba bsnams// ma rungs 'dul ba'i cha lugs can// thams cad 'gugs la phyag 'tshal lo// khro chen dbyug pa sngon po ni// zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa na// dbyug to g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad// sngo sangs kun 'dul khyod la bstod// khro bo'i rgyal po stobs po che// utpal mdog 'dra phyag gnyis pa/

g.yas pa rdo rje sdigs mdzub g.yon// bdud 'dul drag po khyod la bstod// kun kyang sbrul dang stag lpags brgyan// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog sngo// g.yon brkyang pad nyi'i gdan la bzhugs// steng gi phyogs su bzhugs pa yi// gnas gtsang lha yi bu gnyis po// lha yi rgyan dang na bza' 'dzin// phyag na bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams// bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun kun la snyoms// dag pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig nang par sngar langs nas// bstod pa 'di yis dus kun du// 'khor dang bcas la bstod byas nas// blo dang tshe rnams 'phel bar 'gyur// dpal dang 'byor pa'i dngos grub ster// mchog gi (370)dngos grub thob par 'gyur// gus pa'i yid kyis bsam pa yi// rtse gcig sems kyis bstod par bya/ /bdag bskyed kyi dmigs pa mdun bskyed la gong rje zhing*/ sngar gyi phyag rgya des me tog bzung ste gzungs ring tshar gcig bton nas/ /swā hā zhes brjod pa'i me tog mdun bskyed la dor ro// de nas bzlas pa byed pa yin la des gzungs ring ngam rtsa sngags ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba trai lo kya pra ti bi shiṣṭā ya/ buddha ya te na maḥ tadya thā/ oṃ bhrūm̐ bhrūm̐ bhrūm̐/ sho dha ya sho dha ya bi sho dha ya bi sho dha ya/ a sa ma sa manta a ba bhā sa spha ra ṇa ga ti ga ga na swa bhā wa bi shuddhe/ a bhi ṣiñtsantu mā/ sarba ta thā ga tā/ su ga ta ba ra ba tsa na a mṛ ta/ a bhi ṣai kai ra ma hā mu drā mant+ra pa deḥ ā ha ra ā ha ra/ ma ma ā yussaṃ dhā ra ṇi/ sho dha ya sho dha ya/ bi sho dha ya bi sho dha ya/ ga ga na swa bhā ba bi shuddhe uṣṇāe ṣa bi dza ya pa ri shuddhe sa ha sra ra smi sañtso di te/ sarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki ni/ ṣa ṭwār mi tā pa ri pū ra ṇi sa tha ta thā ga ta mā te da sha bhū mi pra tiṣṭhi te/ sarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya a dhiṣṭhā na a dhiṣṭha te/ mu dre mu dre ma hā mu dre badzra kā ya saṃ ha ta na pa ri shuddhe/

sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa bi shuddhe pra ti ni watta ya ma ma ā yur bi shuddhe sarba ta thā ga ta/ sa ma ya a dhiṣṭhā na a dhiṣṭha te/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu ni/ bi mu ni bi mu ni ma hā bi mu ni/ ma ti ma ti ma hā ma ti ma ma ti su ma ti/ ta thā ta bhū ta ko ṭi pa re shuddhe/ bi spu ṭa buddhi shuddhe/ he he dza ya dza ya/ bi dza ya bi dza ya/ sma ra sma ra/ spha ra spha ra/ sphā ra ya sphā ra ya/ sarba buddha a dhiṣṭhā na a dhiṣṭha te/ shuddhe shuddhe/ buddhe buddhe/ badzre badzre ma hā badzre su badzre/ badzra garbhe dza ya garbhe bi dza ya garbhe/ badzra dzwā lā garbhe/ badzrod bha be/ (371)badzra saṃ bha be badzre badzri ṇi badzraṃ bha ba tu ma ma sha rī raṃ/ sarba sa twānāñtsa kā ya pa ri shuddhe bha ba tu/ me sa dā sarba ga ti pa ri shuddhi shtsa/ sarba ta thā ga tāshtsa māṃ sa mā shwā sa yantu/ budhya budhya sidhya sidhya// bo dha ya bo dha ya/ bi bo dha ya bi bo dha ya/ mo tsa ya mo tsa ya/ bi mo tsa ya bi mo tsa ya/ sho dha ya sho dha ya/ bi sho dha ya bi sho dha ya/ sa mantu mo tsa ya mo tsa ya sa manta ra smi pa ri shuddhe/ sarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya a dhiṣṭha na a dhiṣṭhi te/ mu dre mu dre/ ma hā mu dre/ ma hā mu drwa mant+ra pā daiḥswa hā/ zhes pa'o// de ltar na/ de nyid bzlas pa'i gtso bor bya zhing*/ gong du bshad pa ltar tshe sgrub kyi gzungs dang*/ oṃ bhrūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ a mṛ ta a yurda dai swā hā/ zhes pa'ang ci nus su bzla'o// de yang*/ thugs dam bskul ba'i gzungs tshar gcig brjod rjes su/ bzlas pa byed pa tsam dkyus ma'i lugs yin la/ stong mchod kyi skabs yin na slar yang tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar/ arghaṃ nas/ /shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog /zhal gsum phyag brgyad rab mdzes zhi ba'i sku// ye shes dpag yas tshe yi mchog stsol ma// rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal bstod/

/ces bstod/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ bum pa yongs su gang bar gyur/ ces brjod/ de nas bzlas pa dngos la/ oṃ na mo zhes brjod pa'i tshe thob thang la phyag dngos 'tshal ba yin na'ang*/ lag len la thal mo sbyar nas mgo 'dud par byed/ gzungs bzla mkhan bcu yod pa'i dbang du byas nas/ gzungs ring tshar bcu song ba'i rjes su mchod bstod bsdus pa re bya/ de ltar lan bcus gzungs stong phrag gcig 'gro ba yin pa las/ gzungs bcu tshan lnga tsam long bas/ gzungs (372)re re la bskor ba gnyis gnyis 'gro bar byas pas/ bskor ba yang stong 'gro/ 'di'i rigs 'gres te gzungs bzla mkhan mang nyung gi rtsis gdab ma 'khrugs par bya dgos te/ dper na bzlas pa byed mkhan nyi shu yod na lnga tshan bcu dang*/ bzlas pa byed mkhan lnga las med na nyi shu tshan bcu byed dgos pa bzhin no// gtor ma stong phrag bsngo ba ni/ bsangs sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ de nas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mgron thams cad la dmigs nas/ a kā ro 'i sngags kho na stong phrag gcig gis bsngo ba las/ sngags brgya brgya song ba'i mtshams su/ mchod sbyin gtor ma dam pa 'dis// 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig /dam can thugs dam skongs gyur cig /rigs drug gtor mas tshims gyur nas// lan chags bu lon khyer ba dang*// bla med byang chub myur thob shog /de rjes 'bud dkrol gyi sgra dang bcas te/ 'dod don gang yin pa de gsol ba drag tu gdab bo// gsum pa ni/ gtor ma dang po/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐ gis bsang*/ oṃ badzra dzwa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra na hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis sbyang*/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇāṃ ā dya nutpanna twa ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ byin gyis brlabs/ gzungs ring tshar gcig gi mthar/ uṣṇī ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra bhyaḥ oṃ a kā ro sogs btags pa lan bdun gyis phul/ mchod bstod bsdus pa byas la/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang bskal pa bzang*// longs (373)spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun stsol sdong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog

/ces gsol ba btab/ rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma'ang gong bzhin byin gyis brlab/ oṃ dhṛṣṭa raṣṭā ya/ oṃ a kā ro sogs btags pa lan gsum/ oṃ bai ru ḍha kā ya/ dang*/ oṃ bi rū ya/ dang*/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇā ya dang zhes pa rnams la'ang*/ a kā ro sbyar ba lan gsum gyis phul/ rgyal po chen po dpal ldan pa// mar gad mdog can pi waṃ 'dzin// dri za'i tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i// yul 'khor srung la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod thams cad shar phyogs su bde legs su gyur cig /dpa' bo chen po stobs po che// kha dog sngon po ral gri 'dzin// grul bum tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i// 'phags skyes po la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod thams cad lho phyogs su bde legs su gyur cig /mnga' bdag chen po mthu bo che// kha dog dmar po sbrul zhags 'dzin// klu yi tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i// mig mi bzang la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod thams cad nub phyogs su bde legs su gyur cig /(374)ded dpon chen po gser mdog can// be con dang ni ne'u le 'dzin// gnod sbyin tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i// rnam thos sras la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod thams cad byang phyogs su bde legs su gyur cig /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang bskal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob par cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun stsol sdong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog

/'dod don zhu/ de nas bar 'dir gtor ma cha gsum btang*/ rjes chog ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la/ mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla bre dang*// mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye zhing*// mchod yon sna tshogs rab tu bkram byas nas// rgyal ba bdag nyid chen po de dag mchod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇī ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa dang*/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ zhabs bsil dang*/ me tog dang*/ bdug spos dang*/ snang gsal dang*/ dri mchog dang*/ zhal zas dang*/ sil snyan rnams kyang*/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/(375)dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gandhe/ nai bi dya/ shabda sogs kyis tshigs bcad dang spel ba'am/ ma spel kyang rung ste/ arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang rung gis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa thob par mdzad du gsol/ sdig sgrib ma lus pa byang zhing dag nas/ 'chi ba med pa tshe yi dngos grub thob par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab bdag bskyed kyi lha gshegs su gsol bar 'dod na/ rjes chog gi sngon du/ bdag bskyed kyi lha ye shes pa mdun du bzhugs par gyur/ ces brjod la/ mchod bstod man chad lhan cig tu byas na zor yang zhing*/ so sor byed na mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams gshegs su gsol ba'i rjes la byed pa yin kyang*/ rgyud sde gong ma'i sgrub pa pos ni gshegs su mi gsol ba nyid bzang bar mthong ngo*// de nas yig brgya mang du bzlas/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid rtsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/

kyis bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// oṃ badzra muḥ zhes pas mgron rnams gshegs su gsol/ mchod rten dang ras bris la dmigs nas brtan bzhugs bya/ dge ba bsngo ba dang shis brjod rol mo dang bcas pa bya/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bsdu zhing*/ (376)bum chus sems can thams cad pa man gdams par bya ba las bsgrub bya dmigs bsal can la/ khrus kyi rjes su bzung dgos na/ dang po zhi ba dang*/ zhi drag phyed ma dang*/ drag po'i sgo nas bgegs sbyangs/ de rjes til lam nyungs kar gyis sdig sgrib sbyang ba yang byas na legs/ de nas snying ga'i 'od zer gyis/ dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig gis spyan drangs/ mchod bstod bsdus pa dang*/ bsgrub bya'i don du gsol ba 'debs tshul tsam byas nas/ nam mkha'i lha rnams kyis cho ga mdzad par mos nas/ dngos su bkru bya ba bsrung gsum/ bkra shis dang bcas pa bya/ nam mkha'i lha mchod nas rang bzhin gyi gnas su bzhugs par bsgom/ bkru bya ba bsrung gsum gyi bya ba 'di gzhan dang 'dra ba'i phyir/ 'dir zhib par ma smos so// byin rlabs mchog gi gzi byin zla bral pas// sdig 'phrog mi 'gyur tshe yi dpal ster ba// gang gi cho ga'i lag len gsal por bshad// dge 'dis tshe dpag med pa'i gnas thob shog /ces pa'ang shin tu nyer mkhor mthong nas rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// dge legs 'phel/// /
